Inspect the codebase and produce a prioritized list (High/Medium/Low) split into:
requested work, necessary technical fixes, optional features, long-term architecture.
For each item: what, problem solved, benefit, how, effort, risks, affected areas, evidence (file:line) or "hypothesis".
Avoid feature bloat; challenge assumptions.
